extensionDescription.message: Adds a gentle cushion before reading emotionally heavy wording on X. Post text and detection results are not sent externally.

cushionBody.message: This post may include wording that could feel emotionally heavy.

cushionDismissedMessage.message: You chose not to read this for now.

cushionDismissedBody.message: You can show the content later if you want to read it.

cushionDismissedLeavePost.message: You can also leave this post without viewing the content.

cushionDismissedDistanceOptions.message: If needed, you can use features on X, such as mute or block, to give yourself some distance from that account.

cushionProtectYourHeartLink.message: Learn more about protecting your peace of mind

reasonExistenceDenial.message: This may contain wording close to existence denial.

reasonPersonalityAttack.message: This may contain wording close to a personality attack.

reasonDiscriminatoryAttack.message: This may contain wording close to an attribute-based attack.

reasonSevereInsult.message: This may contain wording close to a severe insult.

reasonPersistentAttack.message: This may contain wording that could feel pressuring.

reasonThreatOrHarm.message: This may contain wording that could raise safety concerns.

reasonDoxxingOrPrivacyRisk.message: This may contain wording related to personal information or safety.

reasonGeneric.message: This may contain wording that could feel emotionally heavy.

cushionGuidanceNote.message: This is supplementary guidance based on fixed rules.

cushionGuidanceTendencyPersonalSafety.message: Language that may relate to personal safety

cushionGuidanceTendencyPrivacy.message: Language that may relate to personal information or privacy

cushionGuidanceTendencyCircumstancesOrBa.message: Strong language related to someone's circumstances or background

reasonPotentialBurden.message: This may contain wording that could place an emotional burden on the reader.

popupTagline.message: A gentle cushion for words on X

optionsDescription.message: Settings for adding a gentle cushion before reading words that arrive on X.

optionSensitivityLowDescription.message: Shows cushions mainly for stronger expressions.

optionSensitivityHighDescription.message: Shows cushions more easily, including for slightly lighter risk expressions.

popupSensitivityCompactSummary.message: Low = stronger expressions / Standard = usual / High = more sensitive

optionPrivacyNote.message: Post text and detection results are not sent to external servers.

optionStorageNote.message: Settings are stored in this browser.

optionReloadNote.message: ON/OFF and display sensitivity changes will take effect after reloading the open X page.

distanceTermsSectionTitle.message: Words you'd like some distance from

distanceTermsDescription.message: You can register words, short phrases, or hashtags you'd like some distance from for now. When a post contains registered text, a gentle cushion appears before you read it.

distanceTermsPrivacy.message: Registered text is stored in this browser and is not sent externally.

distanceTermsMasterNote.message: Turning this feature off does not delete registered words or their individual ON/OFF settings.

distanceTermsAddHeading.message: Add a word, phrase, or hashtag

distanceTermsEmpty.message: No words are registered yet. If there's something you'd like some distance from for now, you can add it above.

distanceTermsMaximum.message: You can register up to 30 entries. To add another, delete an entry you no longer need.

distanceTermsValidationSafetyLength.message: This entry is too long. Please enter a shorter one.

distanceTermsValidationLineBreakTab.message: Enter the text on one line without line breaks or tabs.

distanceTermsValidationForbidden.message: This entry contains characters that cannot be registered. Some non-visible characters cannot be registered. Please check your input.

distanceTermsAddFailure.message: Could not add this entry. Your input has been kept. Please try again.

distanceTermsSettingChangeFailure.message: Could not change this setting. Please try again.

distanceTermsDeleteFailure.message: Could not delete this entry. Please try again.

distanceTermsDeleteDialogCannotRestore.message: Once deleted, this entry cannot be restored.

distanceTermsDeleteDialogReregister.message: If you need it again, you'll need to register it again.

distanceTermsPartialTitle.message: Some registered settings could not be read

distanceTermsPartialBody.message: Cushions will continue using the settings that could be read. Saved data has not been changed automatically.

distanceTermsPartialDialogBody.message: Entries that could not be read correctly will be deleted.

distanceTermsPartialDialogKeepsValid.message: Entries that were read correctly will not be deleted.

distanceTermsWholeInvalidTitle.message: Could not read “Words you'd like some distance from” settings

distanceTermsWholeInvalidBody.message: Cushions based on registered words are temporarily paused because the saved settings could not be read safely.

distanceTermsWholeInvalidFixedRules.message: Cushions based on the existing fixed rules will continue to work.

distanceTermsResetSuccess.message: “Words you'd like some distance from” settings have been reset.

distanceTermsResetDialogTitle.message: Reset “Words you'd like some distance from” settings?

distanceTermsResetDialogBody.message: All registered words and their individual ON/OFF settings will be deleted, and this feature will return to its initial state.

distanceTermsResetDialogOtherSettings.message: Other Kotoba Uke Mimamori settings will not be changed.

distanceTermsUnsupportedTitle.message: This settings format cannot be read by the current version

distanceTermsUnsupportedBody.message: Your “Words you'd like some distance from” settings have been left unchanged.

distanceTermsUnsupportedPaused.message: Cushions based on registered words are temporarily paused.

distanceTermsReadErrorBody.message: This may be a temporary issue. Your saved settings have not been changed.

distanceTermsRecoveryUnknown.message: We couldn't confirm that the action was completed. The latest saved settings have been reloaded. Check the current state and try again if needed.
